AMENDMENT: there is NO REAL HUMAN DATA in this repository -- verified. WOG is hand-authored on BOTH sides (model AND recall paraphrases); BirthdayInterview is synthetic with invented content; no participant/consent data files exist.

So this spike TESTS THE PATH, NOT THE SCIENCE. Start from WOG's raw text as instructed -- that still exercises the untested construction path -- but any number produced is a fact about our pipeline on our own prose, NOT a finding about recall. The FRICTION LOG remains fully valid and remains the deliverable: friction is friction regardless of who authored the text.
